SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.code, i.name, i.description, i.default_duration_minutes, i.status, i.version, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.deleted FROM service_item i JOIN window_item_rel r ON r.item_id = i.id AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN service_window w ON w.id = r.window_id AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE w.outlet_id = #{outletId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM service_item WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND id IN #{id}
